use std::collections::BTreeMap;
fn main() {
    let value = (7u32, vec![11u16, 29], String::from("roundtrip"));
    let bytes = bincode::serialize(&value).unwrap();
    let decoded: (u32, Vec<u16>, String) = bincode::deserialize(&bytes).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(decoded, value);
    let text = bincode::serialize("borrowed").unwrap();
    let borrowed: &str = bincode::deserialize(&text).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(borrowed, "borrowed");
    let mut map = BTreeMap::new();
    map.insert(String::from("a"), 13u32);
    map.insert(String::from("b"), 27);
    let encoded = bincode::serialize(&map).unwrap();
    let restored: BTreeMap<String, u32> = bincode::deserialize(&encoded).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(restored, map);
    println!("{:?}", bytes);
    println!("{} {}", borrowed, restored.len());
}
